# Why each nf-core pipeline that fails in run_test_workflows.txt cannot run, and how
# Nextflow 26.04.6 fails on it, recorded by run_evidence.py. Each block gives the
# pipelines, then `=`, the kind (`invalid`, `missing` or `unsupported (decision N)`)
# and why in one plain sentence, then what Nextflow was asked (`$`) and the lines of
# its output that show it (`>`). Tools that the pipelines call are stood in by a
# shell function that prints `1.0`.

alleleexpression
= invalid: the test profile gives no `--input` samplesheet, which the pipeline requires
$ NXF_SYNTAX_PARSER=v1 nextflow run alleleexpression -profile test -stub-run --outdir <out>
> [ERROR] Input samplesheet not specified!

ampliseq
= invalid: an output of CUTADAPT reads `outformat`, which only its script sets, so a stub run fails
$ NXF_SYNTAX_PARSER=v1 nextflow run ampliseq -profile test -stub-run --outdir <out>
> [ERROR] ERROR ~ No such variable: outformat
>  -- Check script '<pipeline>/modules/nf-core/cutadapt/main.nf' at line: 14 or see '.nextflow.log' file for more details

bacmodel
= invalid: the BACMODEL_SUMMARY stub makes an empty versions.yml, which processVersionsFromYAML reads as null
$ NXF_SYNTAX_PARSER=v1 nextflow run bacmodel -profile test -stub-run --outdir <out>
> [ERROR] ERROR ~ Cannot invoke method collectEntries() on null object
>  -- Check script '<pipeline>/subworkflows/nf-core/utils_nfcore_pipeline/main.nf' at line: 82 or see '.nextflow.log' file for more details

cageseq
= unsupported (decision 14): the pipeline is a DSL1 script, whose processes read `from` and write `into` channels, which iunctus leaves out and Nextflow 26.04.6 does not run either
$ NXF_SYNTAX_PARSER=v1 nextflow run cageseq -profile test -stub-run --outdir <out>
> [ERROR] ERROR ~ No signature of method: groovyx.gpars.dataflow.DataflowBroadcast.into() is applicable for argument types: (_nf_script_<hash>$_runScript_closure7) values: [_nf_script_<hash>$_runScript_closure7@<address>]

callingcards
= unsupported (decision 16): SEQKIT_SPLIT2 has no stub, so it needs seqkit to split the reads into the files whose names the pipeline reads, and the mock executor only makes up one file
$ NXF_SYNTAX_PARSER=v1 nextflow run callingcards -profile test -stub-run --outdir <out>
> [ERROR] ERROR ~ Error executing process > 'NFCORE_CALLINGCARDS:CALLINGCARDS:YEAST_PREPARE_READS:SEQKIT_SPLIT2 (run_6177)'
>   Missing output file(s) `**/*.gz` expected by process `NFCORE_CALLINGCARDS:CALLINGCARDS:YEAST_PREPARE_READS:SEQKIT_SPLIT2 (run_6177)`

chipseq
pathogensurveillance
= unsupported (decision 16): SAMPLESHEET_CHECK has no stub, so it needs its script to write the samplesheet that the pipeline reads, and the mock executor only makes up an empty file
$ NXF_SYNTAX_PARSER=v1 nextflow run chipseq -profile test -stub-run --outdir <out>  # with a `python3` that prints '1.0', with a `Rscript` that prints '1.0'
> [ERROR] ERROR ~ Error executing process > 'NFCORE_CHIPSEQ:CHIPSEQ:INPUT_CHECK:SAMPLESHEET_CHECK (samplesheet_test.csv)'
>   Missing output file(s) `*.csv` expected by process `NFCORE_CHIPSEQ:CHIPSEQ:INPUT_CHECK:SAMPLESHEET_CHECK (samplesheet_test.csv)` (note: input files are not included in the default matching set)

circrna
= invalid: the MAJORITY_VOTE stub makes no `mirna.targets.tsv`, which the process declares (shown with a small script, as Nextflow first stops at SEQKIT_SPLIT, which has no stub and needs seqkit)
